citations.text: White, J. G., Southgate, E., Thomson, J. N., Brenner, S. (1986). The Structure of the Nervous System of the Nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. B 314, 1-340.

description: Directed weighted multigraph of all synaptic connections in the adult hermaphrodite C. elegans. Includes chemical synapses (Sp, S, R, Rp), gap junctions (EJ), and neuromuscular junctions (NMJ). Edge weight = synapse count. Contains self-loops (autapses). Data from White et al. 1986 via WormAtlas.
name: C. elegans Hermaphrodite Full Connectome
